rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); TextShaper's multi-line metrics read SkParagraph LineMetrics fHeight as a running paragraph total, which the shipped library does not report (TextLine::getMetrics assigns each line its own advance), so later lines with a taller fallback face lost their ascent, descent or leading. The max-over-lines rule moves into the public pure function paragraph_text_extents with a control test that pins the library's per-line semantics. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging or source-authority boundary moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'Paragraph extents take a taller later line'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkParagraph reports LineMetrics fHeight per line'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'TextShaper multiline metrics enclose each line shaped alone'
